title: A guarded update script that brings the live Alli Rae Space to the current Designer build
detail: Follows LIVE-1493. scripts/seed-alli-rae-update.mts prints one SQL transaction for the owner: it stops unless the Space alli-rae exists once and its saved site is still revision 1, backs up the old preferences and editor state, saves the new site as revision 2 through save_website_editor, and merges the new siteFooter and siteMenu into preferences. Not run by the PR. The claim token and plan are untouched.
